necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting. This monitoring is critical for managing the patient's condition associated with diagnosis code I47.1.
